reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount, findOrCreateBank, server-config and syncAccount dispatch, and all providers share one pre-link guard, but the replace path copies unlinkAccount's field reset instead of extracting it.

duplication.why: The account-unlink field reset is copied from unlinkAccount into the guard, the guard call with replaceExistingLink is repeated in six provider wrappers rather than placed once in linkBankSyncAccount, and downloadFintegraTransactions copies the Akahu download pattern.

placement.why: Guard, link handler and download function sit in accounts/app.ts and accounts/sync.ts next to their provider siblings, though a guard named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked also checks closed accounts and mutates another account.

scope.why: Changes cover only the four requested steps (duplicate-link refusal, Fintegra provider, closed-account refusal, replace flag) with tests.

maintainability.why: The single guard keeps the link rules together, but its widening responsibilities, six repeated call sites and a second copy of the unlink reset make future changes easy to miss.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked re-implements the local unlink (db.updateAccount clearing link fields) from unlinkAccount instead of sharing it

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts accumulates a replaceExistingLink flag, a closed-account branch and a replace-and-unlink branch on top of its duplicate-link check; every provider wrapper (including the new linkFintegraAccount) calls it separately rather than linkBankSyncAccount owning it
